newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Mossgas gets $115 mln loans for gas fields.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Mossgas gets $115 mln loans for gas fields.

text.p: South Africa's state-run Central Energy Fund said on Monday it had signed loans worth $115 million for fuel-from-gas producer Mossgas to finance development of the FAH and FAR satellite gas fields.
Development of the fields was approved by the government earlier this year and, together with compression of the FA field, will extend the life of the Mossgas plant through until 2001.

CEF said two loan agreements were signed with Kleinwort Benson Ltd. One is a $65 million five-year ECGD-guaranteed loan facility and the other a $10 million five-year commercial loan. The money will be used to design, manufacture, supply, install and commission subsea production equipment and pipelines.

A $40 million club loan agreement arranged jointly by Fuji Bank Ltd and First National Bank SA Ltd was also signed at a rate of 27.5 basis points over Libor for the first year, and 32.5 b.p. over for the second year if the loan is extended.

Apart from the arranging banks, other participants in the club loan are Tokai Bank Ltd, Banca Monte di Paschi di Siena SpA, Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale, Bayerische Vereinsbank AG, Centrobanca-Banca Centrale di Credito Popolare SpA, Kredietbank NV and Norinchukin Bank.
